get_blob_detector_config: get the default BlobDetectorConfig with camera topics and mask regions for the ROS blob detector node
create_blob_detector_config: create a BlobDetectorConfig dataclass instance to configure the blob triangulation node with custom parameters
configure_camera_topics: configure the topic_by_camera_name mapping to link camera names to ROS image_raw topics
set_mask_regions: set mask_by_camera_name polygon coordinates to define regions of interest where the blob detector will not look
tune_blob_detection_params: tune the scale and min_area parameters to adjust blob detection speed and minimum valid blob size
